name: New Relic Observability Maturity
description: New Relic's observability maturity series organizes practice by value drivers (intelligent observability as the Level 0 foundation, then business uptime, digital experience, engineering excellence), each progressing reactive → proactive → mastery. This codification normalizes that structure onto a single ladder; the source organizes by value driver, and the PRISM crosswalk is an explicit SCALE mapping, not part of the New Relic model. Note: New Relic documentation content is published under CC BY-NC-SA — this file intentionally carries only level structure and short paraphrases with attribution.

levels.name: Level 0 — Intelligent observability foundation
levels.description: The essential foundation (instrumentation and platform capability) that enables all other observability value drivers.

levels.name: Reactive
levels.description: Value-driver practices applied reactively — responding to problems after they surface.

levels.name: Proactive
levels.description: Practices applied proactively — anticipating and preventing problems.

levels.name: Mastery
levels.description: Mature, continuously improving practice tied to measurable business value.
